name: de.hannesstruss.unearthed.InitProvider
description: Unearthed (Hannes Struss) starts this Provider with the app to track when Android restores the app in a new process. It detects that case when an Activity is recreated from saved state.
disableEffect: The app will no longer detect when Android recreates it in a new process, which can disrupt recovery behavior that depends on this detection.
